how_to.title: Turning your Wi-Fi on and off

result.text:
Within the Settings app, take a moment to confirm that your iPhone is connected to a Wi-Fi network. A blue checkmark will appear next to your active connection within your Wi-Fi settings. If you don't see one, tap on an available Wi-Fi network and attempt to connect. (Make sure your iPhone's Airplane Mode isn't on.)
Note: If you're successfully connected to Wi-Fi, but you're getting a "No Internet Connection" message, there may be an issue with your Wi-Fi router/gateway that you'll need to troubleshoot. Apple also maintains a list of recommended settings for Wi-Fi routers you'll want to review.
